553 -> 340. `odoo.orm` is 497 -> 284 and `odoo/orm/fields` and `odoo/orm/domain` production code are both at ZERO; `odoo.libs` and `odoo.http` are unchanged and hold the rest.

Six modelling fixes account for most of it, and each one is a statement the code was already making and the types could not carry.

1. `CommandValue` IS A TAGGED UNION, not `tuple[Command, int, Any]`. Every
   `match command[0]` in the x2many write paths narrowed the discriminant and
   nothing else, so `command[1]` and `command[2]` stayed a three-way union at
   every use. Split into seven per-command aliases with a `Literal[Command.X]`
   first element, and each classmethod returns its own. The second slot is
   `IdType`, not `int` -- `Command.update` is called with the id of a record
   that may be new, and CREATE carries a `ref` there.

2. `translate` IS A DIALECT, not a `bool`. `TranslationDialect.__call__` already
   states the contract exactly -- `Callable[[Callable[[str], str | None], str |
   None], str | None]` -- while `_field_metadata` declared the attribute `bool`
   and `textual` widened it to a callable whose callback returns `str`. Both
   callers pass a callback returning None. `TranslateDialect` in `_field_stubs`
   says it once.

3. `_FieldConvertMixin[T]`, `Selection[T]`. Covered in the previous change for
   the convert mixin; `Selection` becomes generic with a default because
   `Reference` subclasses it and converts to a recordset.

4. THE SLOTS LIVE ON `BaseModel` AND THE MIXINS WRITE THEM. `_ModelStubs`
   declares `env`, `_ids` and `_prefetch_ids` under TYPE_CHECKING with
   `__slots__ = ()`, so mypy read six assignments in `IterationMixin` as writes
   to names no slot holds. `__slots__` is now declared in the TYPE_CHECKING
   branch too, beside the attributes it describes; the runtime tuple is still
   empty and `BaseModel.__slots__` still owns the storage.

5. `Environment.user` IS A `res.users`. Typed `BaseModel`, so `_is_admin`,
   `_is_system`, `_get_company_ids`, `company_id` and `tz` were all unchecked
   reads. It is `ResUsersProtocol` now, and the protocol gains the three methods
   it was missing -- `test_framework_contracts` checks each against the real
   model, so the declaration cannot drift.

6. THE THREE-PART RELATION KEY. `Many2many.relation`, `column1` and `column2`
   are set together and are None together, on a field that is not stored.
   `_get_relation_triple()` says that once and raises; fourteen sites were
   passing `str | None` into `SQL.identifier` and `add_foreign_key`.

The same narrowing shape, each with a raising accessor rather than an assert:
`Monetary._get_currency_field_name`, `One2many._get_inverse_name`,
`Properties._get_definition_record`, `Selection._get_selection`.

FOUR MARKER-STAMPING DECORATORS became one `stamp()` helper -- `_constrains`,
`_autovacuum`, `_job_config`, `_api_model`, `_api_private`, `_readonly`,
`__deprecated__` were assigned onto a TypeVar-typed callable, which is exactly
what `attrsetter` in the same file already avoided.

TWO REGRESSIONS WERE CAUGHT BY THE INTEGRATION SUITE and are recorded because
neither was visible to `pytest odoo/orm/tests`:
  - renaming the `record` loop variable in `_load_records` missed one use eleven
    lines down, and `base` would not install.
  - `self._load_data_list(..., ids or [])` passes a NEW list when `ids` is the
    empty list it starts as, so no imported id was ever recorded. `ids` keeps
    its type and a separate `failed` flag carries the rollback.
  - a third, `BaseCursor.pipeline` raising NotImplementedError, shadowed
    `TestCursor.__getattr__`s delegation to the real cursor: 35 errors in
    `base`. Both it and `description` are declared under TYPE_CHECKING only,
    which is the right shape for a class that delegates.
